## Outcome and scope

State the user-visible or contract outcome and affected capability/acceptance IDs.

## Changes and reuse

Identify shared contracts, schema changes, and reused components. Explain a replacement
of an existing implementation. Do not link confidential task bodies or private fixtures.

## Verification

List checks actually run and relevant results. Identify deliberately deferred checks
and the integration checkpoint that owns them. Do not report mocks as real-tool execution.

## Privacy, rights, and risk

Confirm that content/examples are public-safe and required upstream notices are retained.
Describe permissions, source execution, data reset, or release-impact changes explicitly.
